digest.component_or_area: automated quality gates and lint/typecheck enforcement
propositions: Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after revalidating existing diagnostics.
C901 function complexity enforcement must be implemented as a shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 wired into the canonical lint gate.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rules must be enabled after making three DTZ sites timezone-explicit and creating shared ratchet tests.
Ruff RUF diagnostics (excluding RUF001/RUF002/RUF003/RUF100) must be cleared and enforced via an extended ratchet test.
All newly-enforced gates (make lint, make typecheck, config-check, C901 complexity check) must exit 0 against current origin/main before landing.
Pre-existing diagnostics in enforced ratchet families present on origin/main must be resolved or captured in baselines before corresponding gates land.
